paragraphs.text: After another few moments, May glances round at you. Then you hear the soft scratch of a match being lit. She applies it to something in the grate and tiptoes from the room.
Once you hear her bedroom door, you creep to the grate. A small mound of black powder, no bigger than a thimble, is burning there. It gives off heady fumes.
You may make a Hard  Science (Botany) roll. If you succeed, go to 76.
Otherwise, you may extinguish the powder and sleep: go to 58; or stay awake through the night: go to 52; or you may relax and breathe the fumes out of curiosity: go to 26.
